# Tangier disease (*ABCA1*) corpus search log

```
("Tangier disease"[tiab] OR "Tangier Disease"[MeSH] OR "analphalipoproteinemia"[tiab] OR (ABCA1[tiab] AND ("HDL deficiency"[tiab] OR hypoalphalipoproteinemia[tiab] OR "low HDL"[tiab]))) AND ("case reports"[pt] OR "case report"[tiab] OR patient*[tiab] OR cohort[tiab] OR family[tiab] OR families[tiab])
```

- **Run:** 2026-10-19, by `pipeline/extract/corpus/build_manifest.py` with the disease's query and filter in `configs/diseases.yaml`.
- **Dates:** database inception to the search date (pre-registration §5.1).
- **Hits:** 519.

## Full text

- **Fetched:** 30 of 284 corpus papers (10.6%) as JATS XML from Europe PMC or PMC (`fetch_fulltext.py`). Access status in the corpus: paywalled 204, not_found 50, europepmc_xml 27, pmc_efetch_xml 3.
- **"Paywalled" here means no PMC copy.** Unpaywall was skipped because `UNPAYWALL_EMAIL` is unset. Of the papers without full text, 68 more list a free or open copy outside PMC in Europe PMC (`oa_elsewhere.json`); with them, at most 98 of 284 (34.5%). Not fetched.
- **Relevance yes, primary papers** (case reports and series): 186; with full text 17 (9.1%).
